name: tastedraft
description: TasteDraft monorepo: Next.js web app, Hono API, shared contracts, and the Rust/WASM scoring engine.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @tastedraft/web && npm run typecheck -w @tastedraft/api
scripts.test: npm test -w @tastedraft/api && npm test -w @tastedraft/engine-wasm && npm test -w @tastedraft/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @tastedraft/api && npm run typecheck -w @tastedraft/web
